scientific_integrity: The mathematical statement is proved using an explicit Weyl-coordinate reduction and a complete prime-field cubic-permutation classification. Eight finite-field examples are supplementary exact checks, not infinite-field certification. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Prime fields of order at least five only; linear Gabor-projector operator rank and its full Weyl kernel, not nonlinear pure-state phase retrieval or the entire nonzero singular-value spectrum. An equivalent unpublished or unindexed identity may exist.
title: Arithmetic rank transition for Gabor tomography of the cubic moment curve
